{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"rContext` stores ordered `MessageDigest` entries for the derived provider view. Its deterministic update algorithm is:\n\n1. If the nor"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"malized stable-prefix fingerprint and every existing message digest are unchanged, append only the new tail.\n2. If a prior normalized "}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"message changed, compute the longest unchanged prefix, record `DivergencePoint`, retain that prefix where the effective provider/adapte"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"r supports it, and replace only the changed tail.\n3. If compaction, branch reconstruction, provider/model/account/wire-protocol change"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":", incompatible schema change, or provider capability forbids safe reuse, rebase the derived view and record the explicit break reason."}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"\n4. Never infer equivalence from raw text alone; roles, structured parts, tool-call/result lineage, attachment digests, reasoning/repl"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"ay shape, and adapter normalization version participate in each digest.\n\nEvery divergence or rebase appends a `CacheBreakReceipt` wit"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"h at least `receipt_id`, `context_epoch_id`, old/new prefix fingerprint, provider/route/model/account/adapter-transform refs, divergenc"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"e index, retained and replaced message counts, estimated retained/replayed bytes and tokens, selected-schema hash, break-reason enum, p"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"rovider capability evidence, and the later `provider_dispatch_admission_receipt_id` when dispatch occurs. Required break reasons includ"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"e `provider_changed`, `account_changed`, `model_or_wire_protocol_changed`, `persona_changed`, `rules_changed`, `selected_schema_set_cha"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"nged`, `policy_or_permission_changed`, `compaction_rebase`, `history_divergence`, `adapter_transform_changed`, `provider_marker_strateg"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"y_changed`, and `append_only_unsupported`.\n\nCache reuse is optimization evidence, not permission, Packet Admission, FileSafe, provide"}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"r identity attestation, or billing authority. The cache and divergence records are append-safe receipts; the generic receipt lifecycle "}
{"op":"label","t":"excerpt","x":"and persistence remain Shared Integration Runtime/storage responsibilities.\n"}
